Ariana Arseneault (born 15 June 2002) is a Canadian tennis player.
She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of 428, achieved on 28 August 2025, and a best doubles ranking of world No. 111, achieved on 14 July 2025. [ 1 ] Arseneault played college tennis at the University of Georgia [ 2 ] before transferring to Auburn University . [ 3 ] Career [ edit ] Partnering Mia Kupres , Arseneault won the 2024 Championnats Banque Nationale de Granby , defeating Liang En-shuo and Park So-hyun in the final. [ 4 ] The pair were also runners-up at the 2024 Dow Tennis Classic , losing to second seeds Emily Appleton and Maia Lumsden in the final.
